references.text: The spies were sent out to explore the land, from which it is mentioned here that they returned.
The forty days the spies spent exploring the land later became the basis for Israel's forty years of wandering in the wilderness—one day for each year.
Moses' retelling of the account of the spies who were sent to explore the land and their return.
A parallel account where Joshua's spies also returned after exploring the land.
God's command to send men to explore the land of Canaan, from which they now returned.
